lines.text: Row row row your boat gently down the stream, merrily merrily merrily life is but a dream!
Why does a tiny pebble sink like a rock, but a giant heavy boat floats on water?
Pebbles are solid and heavy for their size, so water cannot hold them up!
Boats are hollow and wide, pushing aside gallons of water!
That pushed water pushes back upward with a secret lifting force called Buoyancy!
As long as the boat is wide and hollow, buoyancy keeps it floating high!
Grab your oars and paddle along the stream of science!
Now you know the floating secret behind Row Row Row Your Boat!
Glide along with us and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
